about: An expression of more than SourceBounds.expressionNodes, 1,000 nodes (chapter 1 § 1.7): one for each operation and each literal, a var with its argument counting one. Invalid: the deliverable note's if has 1,001. Valid: 1,000, the limit.
sentences: Deliverable 'note' if in 'deliverables/note.md' has 1,001 expression nodes; the most is SourceBounds.expressionNodes (1,000).
